# agentic-slides

Build and present slide decks with people and agents.

Keywords: slides,presentation,deck,collaboration,agents,mcp,cli,pptx.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-slides".
- CLI: agentic-slides summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-slides mcp, then call summarize_text.

## Docs
